rule:create-token-clue.definition: A spell ability that creates one or more Clue tokens on resolution — printed either as the keyword action `investigate` (CR 701.16, 'create a Clue token') or as a literal Clue-token creation instruction. DELIVERY is omitted per grammar §1 because the ability is a spell ability (CR 113.3a). Scope is the caster: axes where ANOTHER player ends up with the Clue are a separate shape and are not members.

rule:etb-create-token-clue.definition: A triggered ability on the source's own entry — 'when ~ enters' (CR 113.3c) — that creates one or more Clue tokens for you. Triggers keyed on ANOTHER permanent entering are a different printed shape (§6b) and are not members.

rule:activated-create-token-clue.definition: An activated ability, '[Cost]: [Effect]' (CR 113.3b), whose effect creates one or more Clue tokens for you. The creation must sit RIGHT of the colon per grammar §9.

rule:death-trigger-create-token-clue.definition: A triggered ability on the source's OWN death — 'when ~ dies' (CR 700.4) — that creates one or more Clue tokens for you. Triggers keyed on other creatures dying, and on cards reaching a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, are different shapes and are not members.

rule:attack-trigger-create-token-clue.definition: A triggered ability on the source's own attack — 'whenever ~ attacks' (CR 113.3c) — that creates one or more Clue tokens for you. Triggers keyed on other creatures attacking, or on the player attacking, are different shapes and are not members.

rule:cast-trigger-create-token-clue.definition: A triggered ability whose trigger EVENT is a spell being cast (CR 701.5a) and whose effect creates one or more Clue tokens for you. Per grammar §2 the cast must be the trigger event itself, never an intervening-if condition about having cast (b6 Village Ironsmith).

rule:combat-damage-to-player-create-toke.definition: A triggered ability on the source dealing COMBAT damage to a player that creates one or more Clue tokens for you. `combat-` is a restriction, not decoration (Captain-ratified 2026-08-02): an any-damage trigger is a different axis.

rule:upkeep-trigger-create-token-clue.definition: A triggered ability at the beginning of an upkeep (CR 113.3c) that creates one or more Clue tokens for you.

rule:landfall-create-token-clue.definition: The landfall ability word (CR 207.2c) creating one or more Clue tokens for you.

rule:any-damage-to-creature-create-token.definition: A triggered ability on the source dealing damage to a creature with NO combat restriction (Captain-ratified 2026-08-02) that creates one or more Clue tokens for you.
